name: open-manus
description: Local Agent Workbench for OpenManus with Ollama on Windows 11 and reusable project factory

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('site',{recursive:true});for(const f of['index.html','404.html','docs.html','accesibilidad.html','privacidad.html','hero.css','hero.js']){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,p.join('site',f));}console.log('Built site/ from root static assets');"
scripts.lint: node --check hero.js && python3 -m py_compile tests/test_basic.py tests/test_new_project.py tests/test_scripts_launch.py
